en.headline: AFCD to trial real-name booking for Po Pin Chau trail from September
en.dek: Daily visitor quota of 2,000 will apply on weekends and the Golden Week holiday period at the popular High Island Geo Trail section in Sai Kung East Country Park.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department announced on Friday that a trial real-name reservation system will operate at the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail from 5 September to 7 October.

Visitors entering the one-kilometre trail between 9 am and 5 pm on weekends, the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day Golden Week must book in advance. Capacity is limited to 500 people in each two-hour slot, for a daily total of 2,000. No fee will be charged during the trial.

Bookings open at 11 am on 24 August via the Klook platform for the first weekend of 5–6 September. Subsequent slots open every Monday for the following weekend or holiday period. Each registration covers up to five people and requires real-name details. Walk-in visitors may book residual places on site if capacity remains.

The department said the measure aims to manage sudden surges in visitor numbers, reduce wear on the narrow trail and improve the experience at the Unesco Global Geopark site. Entry to other parts of the High Island Reservoir East Dam remains unrestricted.

zh.headline: 漁護署9月起試行破邊洲實名預約 周末及黃金周每日限2000人
zh.dek: 西貢萬宜地質步道破邊洲段將於9月5日至10月7日周末、中秋及國慶黃金周實施預約制，每兩小時時段500名額。
body: 漁農自然護理署周五公布，將於9月5日至10月7日期間的周末、中秋節及國慶黃金周，在西貢萬宜水庫東壩萬宜地質步道—破邊洲段試行實名預約制度。
上午9時至下午5時進入破邊洲段的遊客必須預約，每兩小時為一時段，每時段500人，每日合共2,000人。試行期間預約免費。預約以先到先得方式進行。
預約系統將於8月24日上午11時起接受9月5日及6日名額，其後逢星期一上午11時開放其後一個周末或黃金周的預約。每人每次最多可為自己及同行者預訂五個名額，須經Klook平台實名登記。如時段仍有餘額，現場亦可即時預約。
漁護署表示，措施旨在更有效控制人流，減少狹窄步道損耗，並改善遊客體驗。預約制只適用於破邊洲段，進入萬宜水庫東壩其他範圍無須預約。
